name: VISTA
description: Real-time video streaming is crucial in surgical teleoperation, yet reproducible evaluation under realistic network impairments remains limited. This paper presents VISTA, a benchmark designed to study how impairments along the forward video path affect received video quality, temporal continuity, and human task performance. VISTA employs Linux Traffic Control with NetEm and a Gilbert-Elliott loss model to emulate five network conditions: Hospital LAN, 5G Urban, 4G Rural, LEO Satellite, and GEO Satellite.
